title: BBRI Risk Sheet
heading: Bank Rakyat Indonesia (BBRI) risk sheet
gridNote: BBRI fell about 40% from its high during this sample, so short brackets rode the trend and every long bracket lost. That reflects this period's downtrend, not a dependable edge; a trend reversal would flip it.
shortNote: On IDX, short selling is limited to stocks on the exchange's approved list and needs a margin account with an approved broker, so check with your broker whether this setup is possible at all.
longNote: This is a counter-trend trade: price is below the 20, 50 and 200-day averages, and every long bracket lost money in the backtest.
marketNote: IDX trades in lots of 100 shares with a Rp10 price tick between Rp2,000 and Rp5,000; stops and targets are rounded to valid ticks. Daily auto-rejection limits can halt trading before a stop fills. The last bar (28 Oct) may still have been in progress when the data was pulled.
